text:
Gold Price in 2025
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2025, the LBMA gold price rose 55.3% between 2025-01-31 ($2,812) and 2025-12-30 ($4,368). The highest sampled price was $4,368 in December and the lowest was $2,812 in January. The mean of these observations was $3,479. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
